data.one_liner: A Dart library providing constants and helpers for HTTP status codes.
data.what_it_does: It defines an enum of all standard HTTP status codes and offers a function to get the human‑readable message for a code. The library is used to compare response status codes in a type‑safe way.
use_when: You need to check HTTP responses against standard status codes.
You want a single source of truth for status code names and messages.
You prefer a lightweight, dependency‑free helper over writing your own constants.
avoid_when: You already use a networking library that exposes status code names (e.g., http or dio).
You need advanced HTTP client features beyond status code handling.
weaknesses: No networking functionality; only status code helpers.
No support for custom or non‑standard codes.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides both networking and status code handling in one package.
